meta.name: tia-portal-mcp
meta.description: Use when the TIA Portal MCP server is available and the task involves reading or modifying a TIA Portal project interactively: browsing the project tree, reading or writing PLC block logic (SIMATIC SD YAML), listing tag tables, inspecting hardware config, running cross-reference diagnostics, searching the equipment catalog, adding/configuring network devices, or running compile checks. Prefer MCP tools over TIA Openness scripts for single read/write operations; use TIA Openness (tia-python or C# skills) for complex multi-step automation.
